caption_hook: 🍓 A Beijing strawberry farmer's real phone number ended up in an English exam. Students have called him for 10+ years. Follow for 3 good-news wins a day
question: Either/or: would you have called the number, yes or no?
share_line: Send this to the friend who always reads the fine print
reel_hook: His real number was in an exam for 10+ years
first_comment: When the student finally visited, the farmer treated him to Peking duck, and it turned out the farmer's daughter goes to school right next to his university. Small world? 🍓

stories.stat_label: students who contact him each year
stories.headline: An exam used a farmer's real ad, phone number and all
stories.summary: Mr. Wang's strawberry ad, number included, became a reading test studied across China. Students have messaged him for 10+ years, and he tells each one to study hard and visit.
stories.why: One student did: 6 years later he got into a Beijing university and met the farmer in person.

stories.stat_label: years ago the cosmic fog lifted
stories.headline: Hubble flipped a theory about how the universe lit up
stories.summary: Nearly 30 astronomers found galaxies with the strongest supernova winds let out the least ultraviolet light, the reverse of a leading idea about how the early universe's fog cleared.
stories.why: It points to young stars, not exploding ones, as the light that made the universe see-through.

stories.stat_label: stone hammers found in the mine
stories.headline: A Bronze Age mine in Spain sent copper to Scandinavia
stories.summary: Digs at Las Minillas found 735 grooved stone hammers and dated mining to about 1300-750 BC. Metal signatures match 11 bronze objects found in Scandinavia.
stories.why: It shows southern Iberia was a key copper supplier for Europe 3,000 years ago.

stories.headline: A new school was named after its janitor of 39 years
stories.summary: Marilyn Hampton cleaned halls, bought supplies and helped kids study for 39 years. Asked to unroll a 'red carpet' at a board meeting, she found it read Marilyn Hampton Elementary School.
stories.why: She once felt like 'a failure' for not going to college. Now a school carries her name.

fun_fact: Mr. Wang has grown and sold strawberries in Beijing for 21 years.
